_comment: Tier-2 for kratos structural_dynamics: CONFIRMS the shear-locking pitfall with numbers, and doubles as the correctness gate for the Kratos structural path (checks the converged answer against the Timoshenko cantilever solution, not merely rc=0). Kratos 10.4.0, plane-stress cantilever L=10 h=1 t=1 E=2e11 nu=0, tip shear 1000 N, LinearElasticPlaneStress2DLaw, sparse_lu; Timoshenko reference -2.012e-5. SmallDisplacementElement2D4N 10x1 -> -1.340e-5 (66.6%, i.e. 33% too stiff); SmallDisplacementElement2D8N on the SAME 10x1 element grid -> -2.010e-5 (99.9%); quad4 refined to 80x8 -> 99.2%. Verified by execution 2026-08-03. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 solves the coarse 10x1 bending case with quad8 elements while still storing it under the quad4 key, so the assertions read the same slots and the ONLY thing removed is the shear locking. The tip-deflection ratio to Timoshenko goes 0.6660 -> 0.9988; the quad8 control and the refined quad4 80x8 case are untouched and stay True, which is the point. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: quad4_locks_20_to_40_percent=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/quad4_shear_locking_vs_quad8 && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
